title: The Stochastic Shift: A New Evaluation Paradigm for Text-to-SQL with AI Operators
abstract: arXiv:2609.21133v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: SQL has been augmented with AI operators, enabling modern data analytics platforms to derive insights from both structured and unstructured data. We observe that while current Text-to-SQL systems can successfully generate these AI-augmented queries, reliably evaluating their correctness remains a critical open challenge. Current metrics, which rely on exact query results and deterministic execution, systematically fail against the flexible, non-deterministic outputs of AI operators. In this paper, we formalize these unique evaluation failure modes and introduce a Multilayered Evaluation Framework that decouples deterministic database logic from flexible AI semantics. We test our approach across both industry (BigQuery) and academic (ThalamusDB) systems. translated_title: 随机性转变：一种面向带AI算子的Text-to-SQL的新评估范式
translated_abstract: SQL已被扩展加入AI算子，使现代数据分析平台能够从结构化和非结构化数据中获取洞察。我们观察到，尽管当前的Text-to-SQL系统能够成功生成这些AI增强的查询，但如何可靠地评估其正确性仍然是一个关键的开放性挑战。现有的评估指标依赖于精确的查询结果和确定性执行，在面对AI算子灵活、非确定性的输出时会系统性地失效。在本文中，我们对这些独特的评估失败模式进行了形式化，并引入了一个多层评估框架，将确定性数据库逻辑与灵活的AI语义解耦。我们在工业界系统和学术界系统上测试了我们的方法。我们证明，传统的执行准确率会严重惩罚有效的查询，对正确翻译的检测率低至25%。此外，即使是目前最先进的（模型/方法）……
tldr: 该论文针对含AI算子的Text-to-SQL查询，提出一个将确定性数据库逻辑与灵活AI语义解耦的多层评估框架，并揭示传统执行准确率指标会系统性误判，对正确查询的检测率可低至25%。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a Multilayered Evaluation Framework for Text-to-SQL with AI operators that decouples deterministic database logic from flexible AI semantics, revealing that traditional Execution Accuracy systematically fails and detects as few as 25% of correct translations.
